ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the potential fraud and mismanagement of Minnesota's Medicaid funding, including the $3.1 billion at risk.
questions: What is the current status of Minnesota's Medicaid funding?
What measures are being taken to prevent fraud and mismanagement?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and mismanagement, and could lead to major reforms in the state's Medicaid program.
